0022600107.text: The Hawks, 1-0 and 1st in the Southeast, host the Rockets, also 1-0 and 1st in the Southwest, in Atlanta's third game of the 2026-27 season, though Houston still has one game to play before this one. Atlanta is without Henri Veesaar (knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture), while Houston is missing Reed Sheppard (knee bruise). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Hawks lost their season series 0-2, including a 117-95 loss in Houston on March 20, 2026.
